ledger.sentence: On 12 June 2026 the World Health Organization (WHO) published a news item on a Lancet Series about postpartum haemorrhage, which means severe bleeding after childbirth.
The series estimates that excessive bleeding after birth affects 27 million women and kills nearly 43,000 women every year.
It also estimates a cost to countries, health systems and families of over US$ 10 billion each year.
The series says that visually estimating blood loss after birth is grossly inaccurate and results in missing half of postpartum haemorrhage cases.
